name: finnhub_market_news
description: Fetches company-specific financial news, general market news (general/forex/crypto), and upcoming earnings announcement dates via the Finnhub Stock API.

category.description: News category: general, forex, crypto, or earnings (for upcoming earnings calendar)

symbol.description: Company symbol (e.g. AAPL). When set, fetches company-specific news

limit.description: Number of news items to return

api_key.description: Finnhub API key; falls back to FINNHUB_API_KEY environment variable
